title: Grand Slam of Darts: Saturday quarter-finals
why: The last two quarter-finals: van Gerwen beat Sykes and van Veen beat Aspinall, setting up an all-Dutch semi-final.

title: Grand Slam of Darts: semi-finals
why: Both semi-finals, starting at 8:00 AM New York time: Doets v Price and van Gerwen v van Veen.

title: Grand Slam of Darts: final
why: The Grand Slam final, first to 16 legs, starting at 2:30 PM New York time.

title: NWSL Championship: Washington Spirit v Kansas City Current
why: Kansas City Current beat Washington Spirit 2-1 at Audi Field for their first NWSL title.
